g.text: Development: recipes and source dependencies change the smallest portfolio
Six dependency-safe engines pass the relative development gate; five visible choices pass only with unrestricted current-source fallback.
Fallback can still call hidden engines. Curves use the best contract-qualified set when available, otherwise the best aggregate set. Oracle availability is not automatic selection.
